received_works.body:
Hello, I have been looking at your page for a while and I can say that I am in love with your character and outfit designs. 
I was hoping I could request an outfit design for my vTuber model, please?

I had already commissioned an outfit design, but even though I absolutely adore it, people close to me don't find the same excitement I did, and advised me to search for something more characteristic for my her. I understand their point of view, so I am here now with a request to you, I would be super happy if you could accept!
I'm really looking for something futuristic, powerful, emblematic but also casual. Some inspiration I love is the game Arknights because I love their designs and outfit choices.

Important Details about Akuutsumi
- Digital Deity – God of Last Judgement
- Half Demon, Half Dragon
- Shark teeth
- Freckles across the nose
- Red tattoos under eyes
- Androgynous (both male and female appearance)
- Slender masculine body
- Height: 165 cm
- Floats off ground
- Half demon and half dragon

World Setting: Futuristic Cyberpunk (Inspiration: Arknights, Cyberpunk 2077)

Personality:
- Logical
- Short-tempered
- Chaotic but kind-hearted
- Loves making jokes, doesn’t always take things seriously

Face/Head Design: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1z2Df2PjXIHvObS2fNudjYmPviJm32p1q/view?usp=sharing

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1nqG7qTn0ih0azxbZBA_gkwsdpQSt5IL1/view?usp=drive_link


Short Description of Akuutsumi:
"Akuutsumi was created in 2101 in a post-war, cyberpunk world plagued by civil unrest and failing governments. Humanity’s answer was the Divinus Protocol—synthetic deities built to embody justice and enforce order without bias.

While the public believed Akuutsumi was created for moral governance, her true purpose was military: to decide who would live, be spared, or face annihilation.
Her code is built from two opposing cores:

- Wrath (Dragon AI): Strategic annihilation, absolute consequences.
- Order (Demon Algorithm): Understand sin, grant redemption—but only once.

Within her also resides Akuutsuki, her protector alter ego—tall, strong, and modeled after her creator, Ignatius Verdantheart."

Your outfit design will be used for my VTuber model and, in the future, a comic book adaptation (with full credit to you as the outfit design artist).


Thank you so much for your hard work!
